+title: 'Model: SessionModel holds the working directory of the session'
+---
+## What
+
+AgentViewKit must resume or reload a session with no copy of its own of the session working directory. Now `NewSessionRequest.cwd` and `ResumeSessionRequest.cwd` (type `AbsolutePath`) go to the agent, and `SessionModel` keeps no copy.
+
+1. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/SessionModel.swift`, add `public internal(set) var cwd: AbsolutePath?`. `nil` means only that no `session/new` or `session/resume` set it (a model that a unit test makes directly). Do not add a required `init` parameter: 33 call sites in the tests make `SessionModel` directly.
+2. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ConnectionModel+Sessions.swift`:
+   - `newSession(_:)`: set `session.cwd = request.cwd` before `register(_:openedOver:)`.
+   - `resumeInTurn(_:)` / `replay(_:into:over:)`: set `cwd` from `request.cwd` after a successful response, for a new model and for an open model.
+   - A failed `session/resume` does not change `cwd` of an open model.
+3. Add a doc comment that tells a host to give `session.cwd` to a later `ResumeSessionRequest`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] After `newSession(_:)`, `session.cwd == request.cwd`.
+- [ ] After `resumeSession(_:)` of a session that is not open, the new model has the `cwd` of the request.
+- [ ] After `resumeSession(_:)` of an open session with another `cwd`, the model has the new `cwd`.
+- [ ] A failed resume keeps the earlier `cwd`.
+- [ ] A host can resume with `ResumeSessionRequest(cwd: session.cwd!, sessionId: session.sessionId)` and no other state.
+
+## Tests
+
+- Add tests to `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/ConnectionModelSessionTests.swift`, with `SessionFactoryFixtures.connect()`, `SessionFactoryFixtures.workingDirectory`, and `ScriptedStubAgent.workingDirectories` to check the wire:
+  - `newSessionHoldsTheWorkingDirectory`
+  - `resumeSessionHoldsTheWorkingDirectoryOfANewModel`
+  - `resumeOfAnOpenSessionReplacesTheWorkingDirectory`
+  - `aFailedResumeKeepsTheWorkingDirectory`
+- Command: `swift test --filter ConnectionModelSessionTests`, then `swift test`.
+
+## Workflow
+
+Use /tdd — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+## Subtasks
+
+- [ ] Write the four failing tests.
+- [ ] Add `SessionModel.cwd`.
+- [ ] Set `cwd` in `newSession(_:)` and in the resume path.

 ## What

-AgentViewKit must resume or reload a session with no copy of its own of the session working directory. Now `NewSessionRequest.cwd` and `ResumeSessionRequest.cwd` (type `AbsolutePath`) go to the agent, and `SessionModel` keeps no copy.
+ACP v2 session setup (https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/v2/session-setup) says that to resume a session later, the client must keep the `sessionId`, the original `cwd`, and the `additionalDirectories`:
+
+- On `session/resume`, the request `cwd` MUST match the `cwd` of the session.
+- On `session/resume`, the client must send the full intended `additionalDirectories` list again. An omitted or empty list activates no additional roots.
+- The client may send `additionalDirectories` only when the agent advertises `session.additionalDirectories` (`SessionAdditionalDirectoriesCapabilities`).
+
+Now `SessionModel` keeps none of these values, so AgentViewKit must keep its own copy.

-1. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/SessionModel.swift`, add `public internal(set) var cwd: AbsolutePath?`. `nil` means only that no `session/new` or `session/resume` set it (a model that a unit test makes directly). Do not add a required `init` parameter: 33 call sites in the tests make `SessionModel` directly.
+1. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/SessionModel.swift`, add:
+   - `public internal(set) var cwd: AbsolutePath?`. `nil` means only that no `session/new` or `session/resume` set it (a model that a unit test makes directly). It is optional because 33 test call sites make `SessionModel` directly.
+   - `public internal(set) var additionalDirectories: [AbsolutePath] = []`.
 2. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ConnectionModel+Sessions.swift`:
-   - `newSession(_:)`: set `session.cwd = request.cwd` before `register(_:openedOver:)`.
-   - `resumeInTurn(_:)` / `replay(_:into:over:)`: set `cwd` from `request.cwd` after a successful response, for a new model and for an open model.
-   - A failed `session/resume` does not change `cwd` of an open model.
-3. Add a doc comment that tells a host to give `session.cwd` to a later `ResumeSessionRequest`.
+   - `newSession(_:)`: set `cwd = request.cwd` and `additionalDirectories = request.additionalDirectories ?? []` before `register(_:openedOver:)`.
+   - `resumeInTurn(_:)` / `replay(_:into:over:)`: set both values from the request after a successful response, for a new model and for an open model. A failed resume changes neither value.
+   - When `request.additionalDirectories` is not empty and `canUseAdditionalDirectories` is `false`, throw `ConnectionModelError.unsupported(method:)` and send nothing.
+3. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ConnectionModel+Initialize.swift`, add `public var canUseAdditionalDirectories: Bool { agentCapabilities?.session?.additionalDirectories != nil }`.
+4. Document on `SessionModel.cwd` that a host resumes with `ResumeSessionRequest(cwd: session.cwd!, sessionId: session.sessionId, additionalDirectories: session.additionalDirectories)`, and that the agent refuses another `cwd`.

 ## Acceptance Criteria

-- [ ] After `newSession(_:)`, `session.cwd == request.cwd`.
-- [ ] After `resumeSession(_:)` of a session that is not open, the new model has the `cwd` of the request.
-- [ ] After `resumeSession(_:)` of an open session with another `cwd`, the model has the new `cwd`.
-- [ ] A failed resume keeps the earlier `cwd`.
-- [ ] A host can resume with `ResumeSessionRequest(cwd: session.cwd!, sessionId: session.sessionId)` and no other state.
+- [ ] After `newSession(_:)`, `session.cwd == request.cwd` and `session.additionalDirectories` is the request list (or empty).
+- [ ] After `resumeSession(_:)`, the model has the `cwd` and the `additionalDirectories` of the request, for a new model and for an open model.
+- [ ] A failed resume keeps the earlier values.
+- [ ] A request with `additionalDirectories` and no `session.additionalDirectories` capability throws `unsupported` and sends no frame.
+- [ ] `canUseAdditionalDirectories` follows the `initialize` answer.

+  - `newSessionHoldsTheCwdAndTheAdditionalDirectories`
+  - `resumeSessionHoldsTheValuesOfANewModel`
+  - `resumeOfAnOpenSessionReplacesTheValues`
+  - `aFailedResumeKeepsTheValues`
+  - `additionalDirectoriesWithNoCapabilityThrowsAndSendsNothing`
+- Add `canUseAdditionalDirectoriesFollowsTheCapability` to `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/ConnectionModelInitializeTests.swift`.
+- Command: `swift test --filter ConnectionModelSessionTests`, `swift test --filter ConnectionModelInitializeTests`, then `swift test`.

 ## Workflow

-- [ ] Set `cwd` in `newSession(_:)` and in the resume path.
